roles.description: Grants permission to view and edit objects and their metadata, including ACLs.

roles.name: roles/storage.legacyObjectReader
roles.title: Storage Legacy Object Reader
roles.description: Grants permission to view objects and their metadata, excluding ACLs.

roles.name: roles/storage.objectAdmin
roles.title: Storage Object Admin
roles.description: Grants full control of objects, including listing, creating, viewing, and deleting objects.

roles.name: roles/storage.objectCreator
roles.title: Storage Object Creator
roles.description: Allows users to create objects. Does not give permission to view, delete, or overwrite objects.

roles.name: roles/storage.objectUser
roles.title: Storage Object User
roles.description: Access to create, read, update and delete objects and multipart uploads in GCS.

roles.name: roles/storage.objectViewer
roles.title: Storage Object Viewer
roles.description: Grants access to view objects and their metadata, excluding ACLs. Can also list the objects in a bucket.

roles.name: roles/storage.viewer
roles.title: Storage Viewer
roles.description: Viewer role for storage

roles.name: roles/vpcaccess.admin
roles.title: Serverless VPC Access Admin
roles.description: Full access to all Serverless VPC Access resources

roles.name: roles/vpcaccess.serviceAgent
roles.title: Serverless VPC Access Service Agent
roles.description: Can create and manage resources to support serverless application to connect to virtual private cloud.

roles.name: roles/vpcaccess.user
roles.title: Serverless VPC Access User
roles.description: User of Serverless VPC Access connectors

roles.name: roles/vpcaccess.viewer
roles.title: Serverless VPC Access Viewer
roles.description: Viewer of all Serverless VPC Access resources
